summary: Unofficial simulator of the Wave Checkout API: create, read, search, refund and expire sessions, with signed webhooks.
notes: Wave documents no test environment or test key: send an Overpass test key in the Authorization: Bearer header.
The payment is simulated right after creation: the response shows the open session, the next read shows the scenario's result.
Insufficient funds: the checkout.session.payment_failed webhook follows the documented example, with "failed" statuses.
Timeout: the session expires at once, with no webhook, since Wave documents no expiry webhook.
Webhooks are signed with Wave-Signature and your test wave_sn_WHS_ secret. API request signing is not simulated.
Undocumented bodies: validation errors are 400, an exceeded quota is 429 and a conflict is 409, the last two without a body.
Retries: five attempts over about 37 minutes, instead of the 3 days Wave announces.
wave_launch_url leads to an Overpass page, never to Wave.

endpoints.GET /v1/checkout/sessions: Find a session by transaction id
endpoints.GET /v1/checkout/sessions/search: Search the sessions of a client reference
